QF.id: VII Market Participants in Securities Markets_49

question.text: SEBI's PMLA-related directives require intermediaries to appoint which two key officials for compliance?

answer.text: Chief Executive Officer and Company Secretary

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI directives advise intermediaries to appoint a Principal Officer and a Designated Director to ensure compliance with PMLA provisions. The Trap: The other pairings (CEO/Company Secretary, Compliance Officer/Risk Manager, Internal/External Auditor) are not the PMLA-specific appointments named by SEBI. Note: Pages 55-56 support the requirement to appoint a Principal Officer and a Designated Director for PMLA compliance; the detailed officer-specific FIU/KYC responsibilities and Compliance Officer role commentary are not stated in the pages checked.
